known_exposure: Prior cycle and cycle1 2024/25–2025/26 outcomes and aggregate scores have already been inspected. This new model family and grid are frozen before their new scores, but no evaluation dates are pristine.
mechanism: Multiclass gradient boosting of shallow trees with fixed prior DC365/Elo50 log-probability offset, identity start, exact regularized 3-class leaf Newton updates and learning-rate shrinkage.

selection.rule: Minimum natural-log loss among three tree candidates, prior blend and selected cycle1 correction, candidate ID tie-break; only the selected new tree model is evaluated afterwards.

tree.split_criterion: squared_error on negative multiclass logloss gradients

features: DC365 vs Elo log H/A disagreement
DC365 vs Elo log D/A disagreement
90d log predicted home shots on target
90d log predicted away shots on target
DC180 vs prior log H/A disagreement
DC180 vs prior log D/A disagreement
objective: Mean outcome negative log likelihood plus leaf_l2/(2*n) times squared norm of all actual added leaf vectors. At each tree partition, minimize sum leaf negative log likelihood plus leaf_l2/2 times squared vector norm, then shrink by learning_rate. This is greedy stagewise optimization, not a claim of global optimum.

numerics.probabilities: Stable logsumexp/softmax, finite strictly positive simplex outputs required; no score clipping or post-hoc calibration.

training: Use exactly the immutable cycle1 prequential feature rows; strictly prior available outcomes in trailing1460days, refit at the inherited league two-month base cutoff. No target-match statistics, own-result fitting, same-day updates, or current correction predictions as training features.
timing: Inherit cycle1 local midnight forecast and next-local-midnight availability assumptions, prior1095day base fits, known source-completion-day resumption exceptions, and no odds features.

uncertainty.interval: percentile95; historical conditional uncertainty, no adjustment for researcher reuse

substantial_gain_target: At least2% lower pooled evaluation logloss than ALL three strong research references, plus improvement over production and paired28-day upper confidence limit below zero against all three references. Failure reported without expanding this grid.
limitations: Pooled historical countries are not held-out countries
Greedy tree splits are not globally optimal
Assumed availability rather than publication timestamps
